title: Welcome
snippet: You can create a developer account by [signing up here](https://front.com/signup?affiliate=developers). You’ll get access to a free developer environment that will provide everything you need to begin building with our APIs. Developer accounts are limited to 3 teammates, so we recommend sharing credentials using a team email like engineering@ if you have more developers working on your team.

title: Plans & Billing
snippet:
Frontend has two plans. AI usage isn’t part of either: the [agents](/agents/overview) run on your own accounts with their providers.
| | Free | Plus |
|---|---|---|
| Price | $0 | $20 per seat per month |
| Projects | 10 | Unlimited |
| Members | 1 | One per seat |
| [Browser runtime](/sandboxes/browser) | Unlimited | Unlimited |
| [Server runtime](/sandboxes/server) | — | 40 compute hours per seat each month, shared across the team |
| Agents | Claude Code, OpenCode, Pi | Claude Code, OpenCode, Pi, Codex |
| [Publishing](/features/publishing) | Share previews only | Up to 100 published projects |
| [Custom domains](/features/custom-domains) | — | ✓ |
| [Analytics](/features/analytics) | — | ✓ |
| Integrations | ✓ | ✓ |

title: Front API: pricing, auth, rate limits
snippet:
The Front API API has paid pricing; offers a free tier (14-day free trial with all Professional plan features; no credit card required); rate limits: Default rate limits apply; can be increased via add-on at $200 per 100 API requests/min per month. Verified 2026-07-26 with per-field source links.

Free tier
14-day free trial with all Professional plan features; no credit card required

Pricing
Platform plans: Starter $25/seat/mo, Professional $65/seat/mo, Enterprise $105/seat/mo (billed annually). API Rate Limit Increase add-on: $200 per 100 API requests/min per month, available on all plans.
[front.com ↗](https://front.com/pricing)
Rate limits
Default rate limits apply; can be increased via add-on at $200 per 100 API requests/min per month
